Locally hosted PDF dependencies, loaded only when downloading a payslip:

- pdf-lib 1.17.1, https://github.com/Hopding/pdf-lib (MIT, pdf-lib.LICENSE).
- @pdf-lib/fontkit 1.1.1, https://github.com/Hopding/fontkit (MIT, fontkit.LICENSE).
- Nanum Gothic Regular, Google Fonts ofl/nanumgothic (SIL OFL 1.1, NanumGothic.OFL.txt).

No external scripts, font requests, or payroll upload services are used at runtime.
